company.shortDescription: Jiraaf helps individual investors to earn returns by participating in high quality opportunities that go beyond equities, fixed deposits.
company.description:
Jiraaf helps individual investors to earn returns by participating in high-quality opportunities that go beyond equities, and fixed deposits.

Jiraaf offers a solution for retail investors to access great investment products for wealth creation beyond the traditional asset classes all via an easy-to-use convenient digital platform. The investment opportunities offered on our platform hits the right chords of high-returns, diversification, relatively shorter tenors, and tax efficiency. By hitting the right mix of all these, we aim to become the preferred choice for wealth creation.

productsAndServices.description: A digital investment platform that enables eligible Indian investors to discover, evaluate, purchase, and monitor fixed-income securities through online order placement and settlement into a Demat account.
productsAndServices.name: Jiraaf Online Bond Platform

productsAndServices.description: Listed debt securities issued by companies, including corporates and financial institutions, that provide interest payments and principal repayment according to defined terms and maturity schedules.
productsAndServices.name: Listed Corporate Bonds

productsAndServices.description: Debt securities issued by the central and state governments, respectively, providing fixed-income exposure with repayment backed by the relevant government issuer and administered through India’s government securities market.
productsAndServices.name: Government Securities and State Development Loans (G-Sec and SDL)

productsAndServices.description: Short-term government debt instruments issued through the Reserve Bank of India at a discount and redeemed at face value on maturity, generally with 91-day, 182-day, or 364-day tenures.
productsAndServices.name: Treasury Bills

productsAndServices.description: Debt instruments representing interests in pools of income-generating assets, such as loan, invoice, or lease receivables, with collections from the underlying pool distributed to investors.
productsAndServices.name: Securitized Debt Instruments (SDIs)

productsAndServices.description: Government-linked securities providing investment exposure to gold through a bond structure, with returns linked to the price of gold and terms specified by the issuing authority.
productsAndServices.name: Sovereign Gold Bonds
